name: octave-claude-tag
description: Claude Tag only — declares the Octave MCP server (https://mcp.octavehq.com/mcp) without embedding credentials, for access bundles where an admin attaches an Octave API-key credential and the proxy injects it at the network layer. Do NOT install in Claude Code or Claude Desktop: this declaration carries no credential or workspace context there — use `claude mcp add` with your workspace URL instead (see the lfgtm README).
